job.title: Frontend Software Engineer / Lounge by Zalando (all genders)

tailoring.headline: Frontend Software Engineer | Java, SAP Commerce Cloud, JavaScript, PWA Integration
tailoring.summary: Senior developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms, skilled in JavaScript, PWA integration, responsive design and AI-assisted development. Proven ability to write clean, performant, maintainable code, enforce testing standards and ensure operational excellence in agile, cross-functional teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Frontend Software Engineer – Lounge by Zalando
cover_en.hook: I am excited to bring my 5+ years of building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell to Zalando’s Lounge Sourcing Platform. My deep experience with JavaScript, PWA integration and AI-assisted development aligns perfectly with your mission to deliver intuitive, high-performance web tools.

bullets.label: Full-stack Development
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented both backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), delivering responsive storefront features and custom UI components using JavaScript and PWA techniques.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST Web Services and integrated PIM/ERP data pipelines, ensuring seamless data flow that supports the rich user experiences your team creates.

bullets.label: AI-assisted Delivery
bullets.text: I leveraged generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, coding and documentation, consistently producing clean, maintainable code and reducing development time.

bullets.label: Techno-functional Collaboration
bullets.text: I worked closely with product owners, designers and international technical teams, translating business requirements into functional specifications and user stories, guaranteeing that the delivered UI meets stakeholder expectations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Zalando.

tailoring.why_company: Zalando’s commitment to inclusive design and its ambition to be the leading pan-European fashion ecosystem resonates with my passion for building user-centric digital experiences. The Lounge Sourcing Platform’s focus on data-driven purchasing workflows offers a unique challenge where my background in e-commerce platforms, API integration and AI-assisted development can directly enhance the efficiency and usability of the tools your buyers rely on.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Zalando to craft high-impact frontend solutions that empower business users, leveraging my e-commerce and AI-assisted development expertise.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce and JavaScript developer with 5+ years delivering scalable e-commerce frontends. I’m eager to bring my AI-assisted development skills to Zalando’s Lounge team. Could we discuss the Frontend Engineer role?
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Frontend Software Engineer (Lounge) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Frontend Software Engineer position at Zalando. With over five years of experience delivering robust e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine strong JavaScript and PWA expertise with AI-assisted development and a proven track record of collaborative, high-quality delivery. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to the Lounge Sourcing Platform.
